title: DeepSeek releases a "creator mode" that allows DeepSeek Harness users to quickly create custom plugins, like a 3D model renderer and a video editing workbench (Debby Wu/Bloomberg)
summary: Debby Wu / Bloomberg: DeepSeek releases a “creator mode” that allows DeepSeek Harness users to quickly create custom plugins, like a 3D model renderer and a video editing workbench — DeepSeek has unveiled a new option to quickly create custom plugins that help users to tackle a range of complex tasks …
